Header: Diconocoris distanti Sinhala – Raenda Makuna; Tamil-Raenda poochi

Prevention: Remove weeds completely 2 feet around the pepper vine
Slash the weeds in rest of the field
Vigorous plants can tolerate relatively high numbers of lace bugs, so apply proper fertilization, don’t overuse nitrogen
Conserve natural enemies, e.g. avoid spraying broad spectrum pesticides
Monitoring: Observe mature plants regularly for following symptoms - Brown colour irregular spots on the leaf and immature spikes.
Damaged spikes become dry and fallen
Direct Control: Hand pick the adult bugs and destroy
Extract. soak 50g crushed seeds with 01 lit: of water for 24 hrs, dilute 1:5 and spray
Rate of dilution – 10 g / 10 lit. of water.
Rate of dilution – 10 ml / 10 lit. of water.
Rate of dilution – 20 ml / 10 lit. of water.
Restrictions: Always wear personal protective equipment while handling pesticides.
Read manufacturer’s instructions carefully before handling pesticides.
Do not eat, drink or smoke while spraying pesticides.
U – unlikely to present acute hazard in normal use.
Slightly toxic to predatory mites and other beneficial organisms.
Do not apply at flowering stage
Toxic to predatory mites, flower bugs, parasitoids and lady bird beetles.
Toxic to predatory mites, flower bugs and parasitoids.
Moderately toxic to lacewings and hoverflies
